Commentary.Commentary: The tourists have a daunting task of chasing 368. Can they pull off something special? It seems highly unlikely, given that they haven't even crossed 200 in the series so far. But the conditions are favouring the batsmen and we can expect them to go for the kill. Join us shortly for the chase.

Sri Lanka wouldn't be pleased at all with their efforts. All the bowlers leaked runs and bowled poor lines. Only Sachith Pathirana seemed to have some control in his spell, as he ended up with figures  of 10-0-55-2. Having said that, the tourists could take heart in the fact that the pitch is assisting the batsmen.

However, after Sachith Pathirana got rid of South Africa's captain de Villiers, it was all du Plessis. Mind you, he was struggling with cramps, but that didn't deter him from registering the highest ever score (185) at Newlands outscoring David Warner's 173. Farhaan Behardien also chipped in with a handy cameo of 36 runs off 20 balls towards the end to take the total past the 350-run mark.

If the earlier three matches weren't hard enough for the Sri Lankan fans to swallow, the South Africans have made their life more painful. The hosts first continued their domination through a breezy knock from Quinton de Kock. After he departed, two old mates - Faf du Plessis and AB de Villiers - stuck around to add to the visitors' misery. Sri Lanka, too, were sloppy with the ball. No one really threatened the pair as they stitched together a 137-run stand for the 3rd wicket.

Angling into the stumps, Faf defends it late towards the gully region for a quick single.
Good length delivery just outside off, du Plessis stays in his crease and defends it.
Slower delivery into the pads, Faf tries to clip it on the on side but he is beaten by pace. The ball goes onto hit his pads.
Fuller delivery outside off, Faf opens his blade and guides it past the point region to keep strike. 11 runs of the last over.
Good length delivery outside off. Quinton guides it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! WIDTH AND DISPATCHED! Length delivery outside off, QDK gets to the line of the ball and slashes his blade at it. The ball races away to the boundary past the diving point fielder.
Back of a length delivery into the body, du Plessis pulls it towards fine leg for an easy single.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Sprayed on the pads, Faf just flicks it elegantly off the back foot through the mid-wicket region for a boundary. You don't bowl those to Faf.
Angling in from a length outside off, Faf stays in his crease and just pushes it straight to the fielder at covers.
Fuller, angling in, de Kock drives it to mid on.

Full length, outside off, de Kock wanted to drive but edged it past the 1st slip, who didn't really have a catching opportunity as it fell short of him. However, the southpaw won't mind it as he gets a boundary.
Good length delivery, outside off, Faf plays it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length delivery, Faf defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Has room on offer and he punches it on the up off the back foot. Excellent shot.  A dive from the fielder was not good enough to stop it.
Good length, slower one, Faf waits for it and defends it from the crease.

FOUR! Brilliant stuff this. It nipped back in from outside off, de Kock moves across and flicks it through mid wicket. The fielders gave it a chase, but even a slide couldn't help their cause as it beat them easily to reach the deep mid wicket fence. Expensive over, 12 runs off it.
Good length delivery, de Kock punches it to mid off.
FOUR! Width on offer and punished. Length ball, de Kock won't leave these, bisects the point and cover point fielder who thought of giving it a chase but gave away too soon. He had no chance.

FOUR! Outstanding. Shots like these make you fall in love with de Kock all over again. Over pitched, he just drove it past the mid off fielder with total control. Holds the position as the ball rolls away to the long off fence.
Length ball, around off, de Kock wants to cut but only manages to get a bottom edge.
Good length delivery, outside off, de Kock drives it to the cover fielder.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Length delivery, outside off, Faf unleashes a brilliant cover drive, but it went straight to the cover fielder.
Length ball, outside off, de Kock lunges forward and drives it just past the extra cover fielder for one run. Good footwork.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, de Kock leans forward and flicks it to the mid wicket fielder.
Similar delivery, around off, de Kock drives it straight to covers.
Slower delivery, good length, outside off, de Kock goes back and cuts  it to the backward point fielder.
Short of a length, angling in, Faf hopped and defended it towards leg side.
Faf du Plessis will bat at no.3.

OUT! IT WAS COMING! They were bowling probing lengths and the South Africans were not able to comprehend the bounce and it was the very reason for Amla's departure. Poor shot to start off with, good length delivery, Amla went to push at it off his back foot but edged it to Gunaratne at 1st slip. Huge breakthrough for the Lankans. The umpire went upstairs to check the no ball, but it seems fine.
Short of a length, around off, the pitch has bounce in it. Amla defends it from the crease.
Length delivery, swinging away, Amla drives it towards mid off.
Good length delivery, around off, Amla wanted to nudge it away but it bounced very late and defends it on the rise.
Back of a length delivery, hip height, de Kock glances it to fine leg for a comfortable single.
Lahiru Kumara will bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Length, around off, it nipped back in and rapped Amla on the pads. Good start for the visitors.
Good length, around off, de Kock rocks back and drives it towards the cover fielder but there is a fumble there. That helps the batsmen take a quick single.
Length ball, angled in, Amla looked to defend but gloved it unintentionally towards long leg for a single.
Similar delivery, angling in, Amla again bravely leaves it.
Length ball, outside off, Amla shoulders his arms.
Good length delivery, around off, Amla prods forward and defends it towards point.
The players are out in the middle. Quinton de Kock and Hashim Amla will open the innings for South Africa while Nuwan Kulasekara will start the proceedings for Sri Lanka with the ball.
South Africa Playing XI: Quinton de Kock, Hashim Amla, Faf du Plessis, AB de Villiers, JP Duminy, Farhaan Behardien, Wayne Parnell, Dwaine Pretorius, Kagiso Rabada, Imran Tahir, Tabraiz Shamsi.

Sri Lanka Playing XI: Niroshan Dickwella, Sandun Weerakkody, Kusal Mendis, Upul Tharanga, Dhananjaya de Silva, Asela Gunaratne, Sachith Pathirana, Nuwan Kulasekara, Lahiru Madushanka, Lahiru Kumara, Lakshan Sandakan.

Toss - South Africa have won the toss and have opted to bat first! They have brought Shamsi and Parnell in place of Phehlukwayo and Morris. Sri Lanka have made a big choice of resting/dropping Chandimal and in comes Weerakoody in his place. Also, Kulasekara is back in the playing XI, replacing Lakmal. Niroshan Dickwella will keep wickets.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the 4th ODI from Cape Town. The hosts sealed the series with a convincing win in Johannesburg as Sri Lanka's woes continued. And now it's that time of the series, where the visitors will play for pride. However, their coach Graham Ford has taken heart from the young Sri Lankan unit and wants them to learn a lot as the tour progresses. South Africa, on the other hand, will look to experiment keeping ICC Champions Trophy in mind. But it's more than just a dead rubber for the Proteas. If they win the remaining two matches, they will gain the numero uno spot in ICC ODI rankings.
